name: lut-builder
description: Build 17-point or 33-point normalized RGB .cube creative looks using explicit gain, contrast, saturation and gamma. Validate a supplied CUBE file’s grid, domain, rows and corner values, then test it on a supplied still using trilinear interpolation. Export a CUBE file, parameters and a synthetic comparison chart in a ZIP, or the transformed PNG. Creative encoded-RGB processing only: no camera-log, HDR, ICC or ACES conversion, calibration, exact reference matching or spatial effects. CUBE files must use a normalized 0–1 domain and a 17-point or 33-point grid, up to 3 MB. JPEG, PNG or WebP images are limited to 20 MB and 4 megapixels. Requires a connected account; derived exports are public.
